articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.snippet: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit
articles.snippet: A final 250 BTC transfer closed the hole left by September’s bug, but the federation behind the network still hasn’t said who paid to fill it.

articles.title: North Korea denies role in $6.4 billion Binance hack after FBI points to TraderTraitor
articles.snippet: The high-profile denial follows FBI alerts identifying North Korean-controlled wallet addresses tied to the largest cryptocurrency exploit in history.

articles.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
articles.snippet: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

articles.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
articles.snippet: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.
